**Analogous Divergence Diagnosis.** The pilot is treating **climate-insurance authority divergence** (global USD/reinsurance actuarial-formula/IP/payout-taxonomy logic vs. local agronomic-risk sovereignty, regional cooperative/religious-authority legitimacy, regulatory-license interfaces for agricultural microinsurance, and intermediary-collective advocacy), **premium-payment divergence** (global hard-currency reinsurance economics vs. local-mobile-money purchasing power, cooperative-dividend settlement in KES/INR/QTZ, agent-commission economics, and remittance-linked liquidity), **collective-trust divergence** (US/individual-app contract logic vs. East African SACCO/cooperative solidarity and mobile-agent trust networks; South Asian Self-Help Group / religious-community mutualism and state-scheme distrust; Central American cooperative-religious hybrid and indigenous-authority gatekeeping—plus legacy formal-insurance distrust gatekeepers: state crop-insurance schemes, banks, NGO extractive intermediaries), **hidden upstream global-actuarial dependency** (risk models calibrated for Western/temperate crop portfolios; parametric triggers designed for US/EU weather-station density; core cloud/algorithm infrastructure denominated in USD; marketing assets featuring non-local farm systems; claim-verification protocols priced in hard currency; translation-only interfaces without vernacular agronomic taxonomy), and **stable-market cross-subsidy blindness** (developed-market/reinsurance capital funding LATAM/East-African/South-Asian launches without audited local-intermediary economics or risk-range verification) as a **translated mobile-app + parametric-banner adaptation**: translating landing pages into Swahili/Hindi/Spanish; running digital ads with Western corn-soy imagery; listing on fintech stores with global pricing logic; delaying core **risk-range ontology / local-model-decoupling ontology / intermediary-collective-recognition ontology / hidden-global-model mapping / local-payment-correlation / reinsurance-decoupling verification / regulatory-firewall design** until a **2026 crisis** (viral claim-delay failure triggering cross-region intermediary solidarity strikes; regulator suspending agricultural-insurance pilot for unverified parametric claims; cooperative networks organizing collective boycott against “foreign risk extraction”; mobile-network agent blockade rendering premium collection impossible; marketplace-fee/mobile-money shock rendering unit economics negative; regulatory boards revoking registration for non-local clinical/agronomic testing; competitive displacement by certified local champions with audited risk-range economics, sovereign-bank/reinsurance supply credit, and cooperative-integrated governance). The correct model is a **modulated global climate-insurance-integrity footprint**. --- ### 1.
